overview: A compact, very safe, spotless city-state built for families: Universal Studios on Sentosa, a world-class zoo and Night Safari, Gardens by the Bay and great public transport. Indian food is everywhere.
fit: Possibly the easiest international trip with a 4- and a 10-year-old.
season: Hot and humid all year (25–32°C) with short showers. November–January is the wettest. June and December are local school holidays (busier). Have indoor backups for afternoon rain.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Singapore direct (IndiGo, Air India, Singapore Airlines)

gettingAround: MRT and buses with contactless cards (kids under 7 travel free). Grab for late nights.

Kids under 7 ride MRT free with a child concession
safety: Very safe; usual care in crowds
Strict laws: no chewing gum, no littering
kids: Universal's Minion Land and Water play areas suit the 4-year-old

Gardens by the Bay and Children's Garden; light show
Zoo and River Wonders; Night Safari

visa: Indian passport holders need a Singapore visa, applied through an authorised agent (e-visa), usually 3–5 working days; ~₹3,000–3,500 per person including agent fees. Fill in the SG Arrival Card online within 3 days of arrival.
